name: Diamond Medical Equipment & Supply
old_description: As one of the area’s largest retail suppliers of healthcare products and services, we provide superior customer service and top quality, state-of-the-art home medical equipment and supplies. We take extra care in making sure that we fulfill the needs of each and every one of our customers.
about:
Diamond Medical Equipment & Supply operates from a showroom at 300 South Rodney Parham in Little Rock, Arkansas. The company states it has more than 40 years of experience in the home medical equipment market, though a specific founding year is not published. Ownership structure and founder names are not disclosed in the available information.

The business functions as a retail supplier and distributor of home medical equipment and supplies, carrying products from manufacturers such as Pride Mobility and Golden Technology. Its showroom offers power chairs, lift chairs, scooters, and other mobility aids for purchase or rental. The company also provides repairs, parts, and white-glove delivery that includes setup and tutorial within Central Arkansas. It describes itself as one of the area's largest retail suppliers and claims the largest showroom in the state.

Customers include individuals, caretakers, medical professionals, nursing homes, and assisted living facilities. Diamond Medical bills Medicaid, all PASSE programs, and major medical insurance plans directly. The staff assists with verification of medical necessity and payment options.

The company emphasizes personal service: calls are answered by team members rather than an automated system, and an after-hours option is available. White-glove delivery, a large showroom for hands-on evaluation, and decades of experience are presented as key differentiators.
